notes: Seven own pages read: pricing, home, channel manager, PMS, revenue management and our-story (all HTTP 200, not thin) and the help center Groups module article cited by four answers, which answered HTTP 403 on the fetch and was then read once in a real browser (pass 2); C17 is classed true from that browser snapshot. All plans on the pricing page are Request a quote, so every dollar figure (C03 to C06, C29) is unverifiable, not wrong. C15 (myallocator) and C16 (Pricing Intelligence Engine) are names the pages read never use; with no dated rename on an own page they are unverifiable rather than stale. Integration counts differ between own pages (pricing 400+, home and PMS 450+); C24 (400+) is true as a lower bound and C25 (about 190) is wrong against both. Cause tracing for C25: six cited pages read (hoteltechinsight comparison and product page, teenvaai, hotelsystemsguide: no 190 figure; travelaiagent HTTP 404; hoteltechreport.com/compare/cloudbeds-myfrontdesk-vs-mews HTTP 403, not readable, so it may carry the figure but could not be checked); cause recorded as not found. The page budget for this vendor now stands at 13 of 14. Generic mobile app mentions (including review complaints that presuppose the app) and cloud mentions are coded as platforms claims per the 8 Oct clarification. Ratings, installed-base and market position lines, hedged advice and comparison lines were not coded. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): C17 unverifiable to true (browser read); the gap lines are feature descriptions, rankings, comparisons or about other vendors, so none was added; tables and vendor sub-headings added C29 ($150 to $400 monthly, q4 Claude 2) and a C03 instance (q4 Claude 3); the ~190 integrations table cells in q7 Claude 1 to 3 are already C25 instances. Consistency check: C25 stays wrong; its proof now quotes the home page's 450+ integrations (same unit) instead of integration partners.
